text:
jess: Quick design review — network step error recovery microcopy. Users are getting stuck when the preflight probe times out, and the current message "Connection failed" doesn't tell them what to try next. Screenshot attached, mock copy below.

matt: +1. We should surface a concise next step list and a clear CTA. Maybe avoid technical jargon like "egress".

priya: Accessibility nit: status changes need to be announced to screen readers (live region). Also don't rely solely on color to indicate pass/fail — add icons and text.

alex: Small copy recs:
- Primary: "Retry connection"
- Secondary: "Open network troubleshooting guide"
- Inline helper: "If you're behind a firewall, allow outbound HTTPS to api.redwood.ai:443"

jess: Here's a short experimental microcopy block I tried:

```
Connection failed
We couldn't reach the Redwood service from this host. Try these steps:
• Click "Retry connection" to try again.
• Check that your firewall allows outbound HTTPS to api.redwood.ai:443.
• If you're on a private network, ask your network admin to allow the above.

Still stuck? Click "Open network troubleshooting guide" for step-by-step checks and sample commands.
```

matt: Love the steps. Maybe reduce line length for the helper text. Also add a collapsed advanced details section with the raw probe output for power users.

dev-deploy-bot: probe-sim: tcp_connect 10.0.0.1:443 timeout

priya: For keyboard users, ensure focus moves to the error panel when probe fails. And make the retry button the first tabbable control.

alex: UX question — do we show counts of attempts or just let users retry indefinitely? I think show "Last checked: 45s" and disable retry for 2s after a click to avoid spamming.

jess: Good call. I'll update the mockups: add live region, icon + text, focus trap to error panel, short helper bullet list, collapsed "Advanced details" with raw logs, and a clear primary CTA "Retry connection". Will post updated artboards in ~30m.

matt: Thanks — can you also include copy variants for translations? Some languages need shorter CTAs.

jess: Yep. I'll include Figma components for auto-resize and max-length hints. tagging @priya for accessibility review once updated. :eyes:

priya: Happy to review. :thumbsup:
